name: GlassKnight Tale
source:
In this visual novel you follow the adventure of a knight in glass armour. You will be confronted with decisive choices in the turn of the scenario, multiple paths await you. 

[From [url=https://noxeria.itch.io/glassknight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你将跟随玻璃盔甲骑士的冒险。剧情的转变你将面临决定性的选择，多种路径等待着你。

[来自[url=https://noxeria.itch.io/glassknight]Itch.io[/url]]
